name: golden_low_sunward
lua: local rp = RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain} local function clearDir(p, f) for _, a in {0, 0.26, -0.26, 0.52, -0.52, 0.79, -0.79, 1.05, -1.05, 1.4, -1.4} do local g = CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(f) local ok = true for _, e in {0, 0.5, -0.5} do if workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p.X, 3, p.Z), CFrame.Angles(0, e, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(g) * 2400, rp) then ok = false break end end if ok then return g end end return f end local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Unit end local function shoot(p, f, pitch) local c = workspace.CurrentCamera c.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable c.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p, p + f * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(pitch), 0)) workspace:SetAttribute("ShotCF", c.CFrame) end game.Lighting:SetAttribute("WeatherBase", "Calm") game.Lighting.ClockTime = 17.3 local p = Vector3.new(-900, 7, 1500) shoot(p, clearDir(p, flat(game.Lighting:GetSunDirection())), -0.03)
